table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Aliasname=i.customicode,
	srinvcode = h.srinvcode,    
	saleinvcode = h.saleinvcode,    
	date = h.date,   
	invdiscperc = h.discperc,    
	flatdisc = h.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = h.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = h.salestax,   
	invgstperc1 = h.invgstperc1,
	looseqty = d.looseqty, 
	packqty  = d.packqty,  
	bonusqty=d.bonusqty,
	godown = (SELECT godown.name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = d.gcode),
	packing = case when i.packcode IS Null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	price = d.srprice,    
	itemdiscperc = d.discperc,    
	packunits = d.packunits,    
	batch = d.batch,    
	expiry = d.expiry,    
	salestax  = d.salestax,
	unitsalestax = d.unitsalestax,
	gstperc = d.gstperc,
	itemname = i.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, h.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, h.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, h.date)))), 
	Person = ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.name)) + ' (' + ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.aliasname)) + ')',
	CustomerAliasname = dbo.accounts.aliasname ,
	username=dbo.users.username ,
	posted= h.posted,
	totalsalestax = 
		(SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
			 Round (
/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
					 * ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round ( (SD.looseqty + SD.Bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
			 , 0 )
		 FROM dbo.srledger SL, dbo.srdetail SD
		 WHERE  
			SL.srinvcode = h.srinvcode and 
			SL.srinvcode = SD.srinvcode
		 GROUP BY 
			SL.srinvcode,
			 SL.misccharges,   
			 SL.flatdisc,   
			 SL.invgstperc1, 
			 SL.discperc)
FROM
	dbo.srledger h, 
	dbo.srdetail d,    
	dbo.item as I LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (I.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users
WHERE  
	h.srinvcode >= :ai_sinvcode and
	h.srinvcode <= :ai_linvcode  and
	h.srcatcode IN (6, 7, 8) and
	h.salesmancode=users.usercode and
	h.srinvcode = d.srinvcode and  
	d.icode = i.icode and 
	h.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
UNION 
SELECT 
	Aliasname=i.customicode,
	srinvcode = h.srbufferinvcode,    
	saleinvcode = h.saleinvcode,    
	date = h.date,   
	invdiscperc = h.discperc,    
	flatdisc = h.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = h.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = h.salestax,   
	invgstperc1 = h.invgstperc1,
	looseqty = d.looseqty, 
	packqty  = d.packqty,  
	bonusqty=d.bonusqty,
	godown = (SELECT godown.name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = d.gcode),
	packing = case when i.packcode IS Null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	price = d.srprice,    
	itemdiscperc = d.discperc,    
	packunits = d.packunits,    
	batch = d.batch,    
	expiry = d.expiry,    
	salestax  = d.salestax,
	unitsalestax = d.unitsalestax,
	gstperc = d.gstperc,
	itemname = i.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, h.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, h.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, h.date)))), 
	Person = ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.name)) + ' (' + ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.aliasname)) + ')',
	CustomerAliasname = dbo.accounts.aliasname ,
	username=dbo.users.username ,
	posted=h.posted,
	totalsalestax = 
		(SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
			 Round (
/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
					 * ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round ( (SD.looseqty + SD.Bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
			 , 0 )
		 FROM dbo.srbufferledger SL, dbo.srbufferdetail SD
		 WHERE  
			SL.srbufferinvcode = h.srbufferinvcode and 
			SL.srbufferinvcode = SD.srbufferinvcode
		 GROUP BY 
			SL.srbufferinvcode,
			 SL.misccharges,   
			 SL.flatdisc,   
			 SL.invgstperc1, 
			 SL.discperc)
FROM
	dbo.srbufferledger h, 
	dbo.srbufferdetail d,    
	dbo.item AS I LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (I.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users
WHERE  
	UPPER(h.posted) = 'N' AND
	h.srbufferinvcode >= :ai_sinvcode and
	h.srbufferinvcode <= :ai_linvcode  and
	h.srcatcode IN (6, 7, 8) and
	h.salesmancode=users.usercode and
	h.srbufferinvcode = d.srbufferinvcode and  
	d.icode = i.icode and 
	/* (i.packcode=dbo.itempacking.packcode or i.packcode=null) and*/
	h.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
order by 
	srinvcode, godown, itemname

objects.name: c_wholesalecash
objects.expression: sum(Round((  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) , 2) for  all)

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  srinvcode  ) + sum( c_invdiscval  for all )

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum(  misccharges for all Distinct   srinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: sum(  totalsalestax for all Distinct   srinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(  c_netamount for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct   srinvcode ) - sum(flatdisc for all distinct srinvcode ), 0)  + Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax for all distinct srinvcode ) , 0 )

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round((  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) , 2)

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( ( (bonusqty + looseqty) *  unitsalestax ) + Round ( c_amount *  gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) ,  2 )

objects.name: c_invsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Round ( ( Sum( ( looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  - flatdisc  ) , 2 ) * ( invgstperc1 * 0.01 ),  2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( (  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0) + Round ( totalsalestax , 0 )
